sections.title: Proposed purchases and blocked items
sections.sql: select sku,location,currency,readiness,buy_units,buy_cost from v_plan where buy_units>0 or readiness<>'ready' order by sku,location

sections.title: Needs attention
sections.sql: select * from v_attention order by issue,sku

sections.title: Baseline forecast
sections.sql: select sku,location,readiness,daily_units,forecast_basis from v_demand order by sku,location

sections.title: Stock cover
sections.sql: select sku,location,days_cover,excess_units from v_plan order by sku,location

sections.title: Missing evidence
sections.sql: select * from v_compliance order by rule,sku
